policy.fluid_mass: sum every generated XML fluid block with mkfluid/count times the common massfluid value
policy.floating: sample masspart and rigid massbody/center/inertia are separate; physical body fields are compared to source XML with explicit tolerances and never substituted for fluid sample mass
policy.control: request/source identity and continuous geometry/control bindings are reported; GenCase-only preparation does not prove solver effective dt/output controls
policy.per_source_material_mass: each mkfluid source uses absolute sample-mass deviation <= 0.03 (3 percentage points) against exact source generated XML; total-mass acceptance cannot mask a source-level failure
policy.scientific_status: QI/QN/QE UNKNOWN; GenCase mass compatibility does not qualify geometry, dynamics, time, output, or observer agreement
